description: This file defines a class AppIdentityDbContextSeed that is responsible for seeding initial data into an ASP.NET Core Identity database, including creating default roles and users.

classes.name: AppIdentityDbContextSeed
classes.description: A static class responsible for seeding initial identity data, such as roles and default users, into the database.

methods.name: SeedAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously seeds roles and default users into the identity database, including assigning roles to users.
